deck: WattZap × VVDN — Initial Pilot Requirement Brief
title: EV Charging Station Pilot
subtitle: Initial requirement for MVP deployment
a11yLabel: EV charging station pilot: four requirement areas — charger integration, metering and power quality, connectivity and control, and pilot success criteria.

cards.heading: Charger Integration
bullets: OCPP 1.6-J interface to the site's DC fast chargers
Zero interruption to commercial charging operations

cards.heading: Metering & Power Quality
bullets: Grid-side three-phase metering with PQ capture

cards.heading: Connectivity & Control
bullets: Secure MQTT and HTTPS into the WattZap platform

cards.heading: Pilot Success Criteria
bullets: Session-level cost and margin analytics delivered
Solar self-consumption uplift measured and reported

content.note: Pilot site: EV charging station, Hyderabad. Working draft — charger models and counts to be confirmed.
